page.title: Documentation · tinyactors
page.description: Everything about tinyactors in one place: the quickstart, the ideas behind statecharts and actors, the guides, the command line, the reference and the design.

hero.headline: Learn tinyactors, then look things up
hero.lede: Start with one program that runs in five minutes. Then read the ideas, follow a guide for each task, and look up the rest.

item.text: Install one package and run an order actor that retries its payment on its own, in Node.js, Python, a browser or C.

term.link: Statecharts and actors in ten minutes

item.text: States, events, transitions, timers and actors, with an order you can drive in the page.
A tutorial of nine steps, from one room to direct messages, each a program that runs.
Give your agent the docs and the skill, and check what it writes in CI.
Writing and testing charts, connecting actors to your code, running a host in production and in the browser.
A payment that retries every 30 seconds runs all its attempts in a test that takes milliseconds.

term.link: Keep waiting actors out of memory

item.text: Two million actors ran with at most 1000 in memory and the rest in a database.

term.link: Change the chart of running actors

item.text: Add a new version to the running process, and move each actor to it with the state it reached.
Record every input, and one loop rebuilds every actor after a crash.
Example applications named after what people build: order fulfillment, billing, a job scheduler, an HTTP gateway and more.
